card.name: Unplanned pregnancy and overdose events
card.fires_on: Words where something happens unplanned or unwanted, mainly 'pregnancy' after 'if' or 'when' and 'occurs', plus 'overdoses' and 'intentionally or'. It also fires on 'Malign' ending in 'ant' before 'Neoplasms'.

modes.label: Pregnancy occurring
modes.description: The word pregnancy (or pregnancies) after 'if' or 'when' in warnings about it happening during treatment.
modes.example: If<< pregnancy>> does occur during therapy with acitret

modes.label: Overdose or accidental exposure
modes.description: Overdoses or 'intentionally or' before 'inadvertently' in warnings about unintended events.

modes.label: Malignant neoplasms heading
modes.description: The end of 'Malignant' in section headings on neoplasms.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning accidental or unintended, such as accidental, accidentally and inadvertent.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about something happening by accident or unplanned, like a pregnancy during treatment or an overdose.
